Question: Assalamu alaikum.I work for a shop.Now my boss shifted me in beer and wine section.Im not happy with his desicion but i havent got choice for earn money at the time...But i'm still looking for another job.My question is - in this condition what should I do? Jazakallah. Answer ID: 16067 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1493/1169/L=1430) In the case mentioned above, you should strive hard to look for any lawful work while continuing this job, and leave this job once you succeed to find a suitable one and keep on seeking forgiveness from Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
